brief.purpose: A local-first co-creative studio where designers and frontend builders turn rough drafts into polished editable interfaces.
brief.concept: A simplified anime weaverbird with one curious eye, a short crest, a friendly beak, and one open weaving loop that suggests a capital D.
brief.style: Vector-first mascot logo with five large color regions, a bold uniform outline, no feather texture, no shading, and no decorative internal lines.
brief.palette: midnight indigo #25224B, creative violet #7151F5, sky blue #32B8F2, coral #FF654F, golden yellow #FFC43D

generation.method: deterministic SVG master and Pillow platform export
